scraped.scraped_description: Tracka is a community of active citizens who monitor the implementation of government projects in their communities.

name: Tracka
tagline: Monitor the status of federal and state projects in your community and take action on implementation gaps
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions

academic_citations.title: Robust Table Detection and Structure Recognition from Heterogeneous\n Document Images
HybridTabNet: Towards Better Table Detection in Scanned Document Images
Feeling ready: neural bases of prospective motor readiness judgements

policy_outcomes.description: Primary Health Centre fence and staff quarters in Ningo, Akwanga LGA, Nasarawa State completed after 7+ years of abandonment following Tracka tracking and reporting
Functional borehole and two solar street lights installed in Ampekrom, Nkawkaw, Eastern region after 40 years without clean water access
Hospital completed and fully equipped in Ungwan Uku, FCT following community engagement and accountability demands facilitated by Tracka
Long-abandoned Magami-Kwajale-Ningi road in Plateau State work commenced following 2024 town hall and petitions to ICPC
New classrooms and additional teachers provided in Kwangwaro and Kwaire following advocacy efforts
Shirgiya clinic made functional, Kafin Lemo school and PHC renovated, new school blocks built in Sangara, health centre completed in Agwarmaje
New hospital underway in Bingin Diwa and three boreholes providing clean water installed
Project monitoring and community feedback leading to improved project implementation across Nigerian states

outcome_methodology: Community-based monitoring and reporting with government feedback loops
published_performance_metrics: 36 states, 19,000+ projects tracked, 17,000+ communities engaged, 100+ reports generated
documented_limitations: Limited government responsiveness in some states
failure_modes: Low government implementation of community recommendations in some jurisdictions
curation_criteria: Projects must be government-funded infrastructure or development initiatives at federal or state level
contributor_governance: Community members can report project status; civil society organizations can submit reports
political_relevance_summary: Tracka addresses democratic participation and citizen engagement. Monitor the status of federal and state projects in your community and take action on implementation gaps.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizing, mobilization, or campaign activities

generalizability_notes: Limited to Nigeria context currently; approach could potentially be replicated in similar jurisdictions with adaptation to local data sources and regulations.
